summary: iter-29 Partner Settlement Record & Cutoff Logic - both backend (16/16 pytest) and frontend (full E2E: history toggle, settle modal, submit, settled-till badge, undo button) PASSED. Cutoff filter (date strictly AFTER settlement.date) verified: far-future date 2099-12-31 resets current contribution to 0 while lifetime stays full. Permission gates work: center_manager/center_staff/viewer get 403; partner role cannot DELETE.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py settlement_view: cutoff comparison uses string YYYY-MM-DD '$gt' on `date` field — relies on stored dates being YYYY-MM-DD strings of equal length. Confirmed by passing tests, but if a txn ever stores DD-MM-YYYY or includes time, the lexical compare breaks. Consider asserting date format on insert.

settlement_view: when include_history=false AND all txns <= cutoff, the center is dropped entirely from the response (no stub). This is intentional but means the badge/toggle UI won't render until include_history=true. Dashboard.jsx already passes include_history=true everywhere — fine.

delete_settlement_record allow-list includes 'manager' in the role check string ('admin/senior_manager/manager/accountant') but the comment/error says 'admin/accountant only'. Either tighten the role check or fix the error message for clarity.
record_settlement: no validation that `date` is YYYY-MM-DD format — a malformed string would silently break the cutoff filter. Add a Pydantic validator or use `date` type.

SettlementSection.jsx canRecord includes 'manager' & 'partner' but Dashboard.jsx showSettlement excludes 'senior_manager' and 'hr' even though they are FINANCE_VISIBLE — minor inconsistency. Confirm intent: should senior_manager see settlement? Currently they get the GET (200) but no UI.
Frontend useEffect fetches /api/dashboard/settlement/history per center inside Promise.all on every toggle — fine for ~70 centers, may need pagination/aggregation if scale grows.
Undo button: uses native window.confirm() — consider replacing with shadcn AlertDialog for design consistency.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings (pre-existing, not introduced by this iteration).
test_credentials: admin@finance.app / Admin@123 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Per-run test users created with TEST_iter29_* prefix.
seed_data_creation: Per backend test run: 1 center (TEST_iter29_C_*) + 2 partners (P1/P2) + 4 approved txns (P1 net=60k, P2 net=15k, total=75k, fair=37500). Auto cleanup of settlement records on teardown. UI E2E test created its own TEST_iter29UI_* center and cleaned up after.
